categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in pharmaceutical manufacturing and sales, including prescription drugs, generic drugs, functional foods, cosmetics, natural plant extracts, and medical devices. It also engages in research and development of new drugs, natural extracts, and health-related products, with a focus on oncology, chronic diseases, and aging-related health products. Additionally, the company provides contract manufacturing services and has diversified into health and beauty products.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Core technologies include advanced pharmaceutical manufacturing compliant with PIC/S GMP standards, development of patented natural plant extracts, and innovative drug formulations such as soft capsules, injectables, and eye drops. The company employs digital and intelligent manufacturing systems like SAP, MES, WMS, and AI tools for production optimization and quality control. It also leverages biotechnology, nanotechnology, and clinical trial capabilities for new drug development.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers include medical centers, regional and local hospitals, clinics, pharmacies, chain drugstores, and direct consumers via e-commerce platforms. The company serves both domestic Taiwanese markets and international markets, including Southeast Asia, China, and other global regions through subsidiaries and distributors. It also supplies international pharmaceutical companies and direct sales organizations.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in Taiwan with significant domestic sales, and has subsidiaries and operations in mainland China for natural plant extract development and sales. It exports products globally and has established strategic alliances and licensing agreements in the US, Europe, Australia, and Asia. The company targets markets in Taiwan, Southeast Asia, China, and other international regions.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the pharmaceutical supply chain, including drug formulation, manufacturing, packaging, and distribution. It also controls upstream activities through in-house development and production of active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs) and natural plant extracts, ensuring vertical integration from raw materials to finished products.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities focus on expanding generic drug pipelines, new drug development especially in oncology and chronic diseases, and proprietary natural plant extract products with patent protection. The company invests heavily in R&D for innovative formulations, clinical trials (Phase II and III), and process improvements. It also emphasizes digital transformation, intelligent manufacturing, and international collaborations to enhance competitiveness and market reach.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of pharmaceuticals, functional foods, cosmetics, and medical devices. Additional income comes from contract manufacturing services, licensing fees from international partnerships, and export sales. The company also invests in brand building and direct-to-consumer sales via e-commerce and health experience centers.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with both domestic and international pharmaceutical firms, including multinational generic drug manufacturers and branded drug companies. It holds a competitive position in Taiwan’s pharmaceutical market with a diversified product portfolio and strong R&D capabilities. Its unique focus on natural plant extracts and integrated supply chain provides differentiation against competitors.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported net revenue of approximately NT$3.15 billion in the latest fiscal year, representing a 6.33% increase year-over-year, with a net profit attributable to the parent company of about NT$304.7 million. Despite a slight decline in net profit compared to the previous year, the company maintains steady revenue growth and invests around 4.8% of revenue in R&D. It has a solid asset base exceeding NT$6 billion and continues to expand production capacity and market presence.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-quality, patented natural plant extract ingredients and innovative pharmaceutical formulations as key differentiators. It offers a comprehensive product range from prescription drugs to functional foods and cosmetics, supported by strong R&D and clinical validation. Its vertically integrated supply chain, intelligent manufacturing, and multi-channel marketing approach provide customers with reliable, effective, and differentiated health solutions.
